repairs.visualReview: Individually inspected production native frame 01559 and exact crop. White hair, textured cuffs, belt, boots and full limbs remain visible during swing; web meets the raised hand. The free hand has a compact folded silhouette, replacing the former long projecting upper/lower finger hooks and the contact-only experiment's three-pronged outline. The crop includes the full free hand and wrist. This rear/side view does not expose every palm surface or accept exhaustive contact/collision freedom. Separate offline traces of the serialized production asset show positive sampled fingertip clearances on both hands; those are diagnostic, not live gameplay proof. Exit zero, zero slow-run warnings.

scope: Pose-only finger repair: ordinary base curl from 60 to 90 degrees; the hash-guarded Arana Gymnast, Batty Brant and Black Cat Venom sources instead use measured per-digit source-relative closure. Black Cat Venom has separately fitted hands. Thumb opposition unchanged; the two original 2099 claw meshes use eased 65-degree distal flexion, others retain 85. Source hierarchy, bind, weights, proportions and materials retained. All suits have full offline regressions; native visual review is representative, not every suit. Native evidence is capped at two images per representative; a crop pair shows one pose, while runs without a crop show the two requested gameplay frames. No exhaustive finger/palm contact or all-catalogue acceptance is claimed.
